cards.gloss_en: a strong or excessive desire for something
cards.ex_en: His lust for power destroyed his friendships.
cards.ex_cn: 他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了他的友谊。

cards.gloss_en: to throw or rush someone suddenly into a situation
cards.ex_en: Fear precipitated the crowd into a panic.
cards.ex_cn: 恐惧使人群仓促陷入恐慌。

cards.gloss_en: someone learning a trade from a skilled employer
cards.ex_en: The boy worked as an apprentice to a blacksmith.
cards.ex_cn: 男孩在铁匠那里当学徒。

cards.gloss_en: in a stubborn, unyielding way
cards.ex_en: She obstinately refused to change her plans.
cards.ex_cn: 她固执地拒绝改变计划。

cards.gloss_en: the act of running away, especially secretly
cards.ex_en: Their sudden elopement shocked the whole village.
cards.ex_cn: 他们突然出走震惊了全村。

cards.gloss_en: something that strongly tempts or attracts
cards.ex_en: The allurement of gold drew many to the mines.
cards.ex_cn: 黄金的诱惑吸引许多人来到矿场。

cards.gloss_en: a person who seeks risky or exciting undertakings
cards.ex_en: The young adventurer sailed to unknown lands.
cards.ex_cn: 年轻的冒险者驶向未知的土地。

cards.gloss_en: a feeling that someone is worthless or beneath respect
cards.ex_en: He looked at the cheat with open contempt.
cards.ex_cn: 他毫不掩饰地蔑视那个骗子。

cards.gloss_en: the low hollow between two waves
cards.ex_en: The little boat sank into the trough of the wave.
cards.ex_cn: 小船沉入浪谷之中。

cards.gloss_en: wastefully extravagant, especially with money
cards.ex_en: The prodigal son spent all his money quickly.
cards.ex_cn: 那浪子很快挥霍光了所有钱。

cards.gloss_en: tempted or persuaded someone by offering something
cards.ex_en: They enticed the cat with a piece of fish.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用一块鱼引诱那只猫。

cards.gloss_en: a sudden violent gust of wind, often with rain
cards.ex_en: A sudden squall tore the sail from the mast.
cards.ex_cn: 一阵突来的狂风把帆从桅杆上撕下。

cards.gloss_en: a place where ships can safely anchor
cards.ex_en: The ships found a calm anchorage in the bay.
cards.ex_cn: 船只在海湾找到平静的停泊处。

cards.gloss_en: stepped heavily on and crushed something
cards.ex_en: The horses trampled the fresh grass flat.
cards.ex_cn: 马群把嫩草踩得平平的。

cards.gloss_en: by ten times as much
cards.ex_en: His worries grew tenfold after the news.
cards.ex_cn: 消息传来后他的忧虑增加了十倍。

cards.gloss_en: rolled about heavily in the water
cards.ex_en: The heavy ship wallowed in the rough sea.
cards.ex_cn: 沉重的船在怒海中颠簸摇晃。

cards.gloss_en: ships that carry coal
cards.ex_en: Several colliers passed carrying coal to London.
cards.ex_cn: 几艘运煤船载着煤驶往伦敦。

cards.gloss_en: a faint; a loss of consciousness
cards.ex_en: She fell into a swoon at the dreadful sight.
cards.ex_cn: 看到那可怕的景象她昏厥过去。

cards.gloss_en: the shore or beach along the sea
cards.ex_en: The sailors dragged the boat onto the strand.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们把船拖上海滩。

cards.gloss_en: local officials who administer the law
cards.ex_en: The magistrates heard the case in the town hall.
cards.ex_cn: 地方官在市政厅审理此案。

cards.gloss_en: a short story that teaches a moral lesson
cards.ex_en: The teacher told a parable about kindness.
cards.ex_cn: 老师讲了一个关于善良的寓言。

cards.gloss_en: fattened up, especially for slaughter
cards.ex_en: They killed the fatted calf for the feast.
cards.ex_cn: 他们宰了那头养肥的牛犊来设宴。

cards.gloss_en: stubborn refusal to change one's mind
cards.ex_en: His obstinacy kept him from asking for help.
cards.ex_cn: 他的固执使他不肯求助。

cards.gloss_en: to argue for or assert something strongly
cards.ex_en: I will not urge that my view is the only right one.
cards.ex_cn: 我不会坚称只有我的看法才对。

cards.gloss_en: a fixed order or fate determining events
cards.ex_en: By some strange decree of fate, they met again.
cards.ex_cn: 由于某种奇异的天命,他们又相遇了。

cards.gloss_en: impossible to escape or prevent
cards.ex_en: A storm at sea seemed unavoidable that night.
cards.ex_cn: 那晚海上的风暴似乎不可避免。

cards.gloss_en: processes of thinking and arguing logically
cards.ex_en: His careful reasonings convinced the whole court.
cards.ex_cn: 他缜密的推理说服了整个法庭。

cards.gloss_en: to make someone less feeling or more stubborn
cards.ex_en: Years of hardship had hardened his heart.
cards.ex_cn: 多年的苦难使他的心变得冷酷。

cards.gloss_en: to continue firmly despite difficulty
cards.ex_en: She persisted with the plan though all opposed it.
cards.ex_cn: 尽管众人反对,她仍坚持这个计划。

cards.gloss_en: strongly urging someone to do something
cards.ex_en: The captain kept exhorting the men to work harder.
cards.ex_cn: 船长不断劝勉船员更卖力地干活。

cards.gloss_en: to test or provoke, especially fate or God
cards.ex_en: Do not tempt fate by sailing in this storm.
cards.ex_cn: 别在这风暴里出海去试探命运。

cards.gloss_en: not based on reason or clear thinking
cards.ex_en: His fear of the dark was quite irrational.
cards.ex_cn: 他对黑暗的恐惧很不理智。

cards.gloss_en: not properly thought out; confused
cards.ex_en: He had only an indigested plan for the journey.
cards.ex_cn: 他对这次旅行只有一个杂乱的计划。

cards.gloss_en: fanciful or foolish ideas
cards.ex_en: His head was full of wild conceits of riches.
cards.ex_cn: 他满脑子都是发财的狂想。

cards.gloss_en: in the common or ordinary way of speaking
cards.ex_en: This plant is vulgarly called deadnettle.
cards.ex_cn: 这种植物俗称野芝麻。

cards.gloss_en: a duty or task that one performs
cards.ex_en: It was his office to guard the gate each night.
cards.ex_cn: 每晚守门是他的职责。

cards.gloss_en: acting wrongly from mistaken ideas
cards.ex_en: The misguided youth wasted his talents.
cards.ex_cn: 那误入歧途的青年白白浪费了才华。

cards.gloss_en: a companion one regularly eats with, as on a ship
cards.ex_en: My messmate shared his bread with me at sea.
cards.ex_cn: 海上时我的同伴与我分食面包。

cards.gloss_en: free from selfish motive; impartial
cards.ex_en: She gave me disinterested advice.
cards.ex_cn: 她给了我毫无私心的建议。

cards.gloss_en: exchanged letters with someone
cards.ex_en: They corresponded for years before they met.
cards.ex_cn: 他们通信多年才见面。

cards.gloss_en: went aboard a ship to begin a voyage
cards.ex_en: The travellers embarked at dawn for the long voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 旅客们黎明登船,开始漫长的航程。

cards.gloss_en: the whole side of a ship above the water
cards.ex_en: The wave struck the ship full on her broadside.
cards.ex_cn: 巨浪正打在船的舷侧上。

cards.gloss_en: to swerve or turn a ship suddenly aside
cards.ex_en: The boat sheered off to avoid the rocks.
cards.ex_cn: 小船急转以躲开礁石。

cards.gloss_en: long spears used as weapons
cards.ex_en: The soldiers held their pikes against the charge.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们举起长矛抵御冲锋。

cards.gloss_en: what follows as a result or continuation
cards.ex_en: The sequel of his choice was years of hardship.
cards.ex_cn: 他这个选择的结果是多年的苦难。

cards.gloss_en: hard, dull, tiring work
cards.ex_en: Washing pots all day was sheer drudgery.
cards.ex_cn: 整天刷锅是纯粹的苦役。

cards.gloss_en: planned or thought carefully about something
cards.ex_en: He meditated his escape for many days.
cards.ex_cn: 他谋划逃跑已有多日。

cards.gloss_en: to go aboard a ship, or to begin something
cards.ex_en: They were eager to embark on the new voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 他们急切地想开始新的航程。

cards.gloss_en: male relatives; members of one's family
cards.ex_en: His kinsmen gathered to help him rebuild.
cards.ex_cn: 他的族人聚在一起帮他重建。

cards.gloss_en: the largest boat carried by a sailing ship
cards.ex_en: The crew lowered the longboat to reach the shore.
cards.ex_cn: 船员放下大艇以驶向岸边。

cards.gloss_en: a long flat boat for carrying goods on water
cards.ex_en: A barge carried the stones down the river.
cards.ex_cn: 一艘驳船把石头顺流运下。

cards.gloss_en: narrow flags flown from a ship's mast
cards.ex_en: The ship's pendants fluttered in the breeze.
cards.ex_cn: 船上的信号旗在微风中飘动。

cards.gloss_en: to dare to do something without permission
cards.ex_en: May I presume to ask you a question?
cards.ex_cn: 我可否冒昧地问您一个问题?

cards.gloss_en: a soft solid made by bees or from oil
cards.ex_en: She sealed the letter with a drop of wax.
cards.ex_cn: 她用一滴蜡封住信。

cards.gloss_en: wading birds with long curved bills
cards.ex_en: Curlews called across the empty marsh.
cards.ex_cn: 麻鹬的叫声传遍空旷的沼泽。

cards.gloss_en: a light stopper made from tree bark
cards.ex_en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle.
cards.ex_cn: 他把瓶塞从瓶子里拔出来。

cards.gloss_en: to have no confidence in someone
cards.ex_en: I had no reason to distrust the stranger.
cards.ex_cn: 我没有理由怀疑那个陌生人。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being empty and unfruitful
cards.ex_en: The barrenness of the desert frightened them.
cards.ex_cn: 沙漠的荒芜使他们害怕。

cards.gloss_en: a small hill or mound
cards.ex_en: A goat stood on the little hillock.
cards.ex_cn: 一只山羊站在小土丘上。

cards.gloss_en: an amount of food or drink that fills the mouth
cards.ex_en: He ate the last mouthful of bread.
cards.ex_cn: 他吃下最后一口面包。

cards.gloss_en: something done to make up for a wrong
cards.ex_en: He made amends by helping us for free.
cards.ex_cn: 他免费帮我们以作补偿。

cards.gloss_en: marking or colouring something with dirt or liquid
cards.ex_en: The spilled wine was staining the white cloth.
cards.ex_cn: 洒出的酒正染污白布。

cards.gloss_en: toward or facing the open sea
cards.ex_en: They turned the boat seaward at last.
cards.ex_cn: 他们终于把船转向大海。

cards.gloss_en: a difficult choice between two options
cards.ex_en: He faced the dilemma of staying or leaving.
cards.ex_cn: 他面临去留两难的困境。

cards.gloss_en: a detailed list of goods or property
cards.ex_en: The captain made an inventory of the cargo.
cards.ex_cn: 船长把货物列了清单。

cards.gloss_en: obtaining something with effort or care
cards.ex_en: He spent days procuring food for the voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 他花了几天为航行弄到食物。

cards.gloss_en: old gold coins once used in Europe
cards.ex_en: He paid twenty ducats for the passage.
cards.ex_cn: 他付了二十枚达克特金币做船费。

cards.gloss_en: the granting of citizenship to a foreigner
cards.ex_en: He gained naturalisation after living there for years.
cards.ex_cn: 他在那里住了多年后取得入籍。

cards.gloss_en: not yet cultivated or prepared
cards.ex_en: The uncured land was covered with thick weeds.
cards.ex_cn: 那片未开垦的土地长满了杂草。

cards.gloss_en: in a friendly, companionable way
cards.ex_en: The neighbours lived very sociably together.
cards.ex_cn: 邻居们相处十分融洽。

cards.gloss_en: putting money into goods or property
cards.ex_en: He was vesting his savings in farmland.
cards.ex_cn: 他正把积蓄投在农田上。

cards.gloss_en: a written promise or agreement to pay
cards.ex_en: He signed a bond to repay the loan.
cards.ex_cn: 他签了字据保证还款。

cards.gloss_en: goods made by hand or machine
cards.ex_en: The shop sold fine English manufacture.
cards.ex_cn: 这家店出售精美的英国制品。

cards.gloss_en: progress or improvement in position or wealth
cards.ex_en: The new post brought him great advancement.
cards.ex_cn: 新职位给他带来很大提升。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being successful and wealthy
cards.ex_en: Years of prosperity followed the good harvest.
cards.ex_cn: 丰收之后是多年的兴旺。

cards.gloss_en: hardship or a time of serious difficulty
cards.ex_en: He kept his courage even in great adversity.
cards.ex_cn: 即使身处逆境他仍保持勇气。

cards.gloss_en: stubbornly refusing to change
cards.ex_en: The obstinate mule would not move.
cards.ex_cn: 那头固执的骡子不肯走。

cards.gloss_en: sticking firmly to a belief or course
cards.ex_en: She kept adhering to her old habits.
cards.ex_cn: 她一直固守着旧习惯。

cards.gloss_en: a statement or fact opposed to another
cards.ex_en: There was a clear contradiction in his story.
cards.ex_cn: 他的说法里有明显的矛盾。

cards.gloss_en: going beyond reasonable limits; excessive
cards.ex_en: His immoderate spending soon ruined him.
cards.ex_cn: 他无节制的花费很快使他破产。

cards.gloss_en: in agreement; not contradictory
cards.ex_en: His actions were consistent with his promises.
cards.ex_cn: 他的行为与承诺相符。

cards.gloss_en: to grow strong and successful
cards.ex_en: The young plants thrived in the warm sun.
cards.ex_cn: 幼苗在暖阳下茁壮成长。

cards.gloss_en: to succeed and do well, especially financially
cards.ex_en: The town prospered after the road was built.
cards.ex_cn: 修路之后这个镇繁荣起来。

cards.gloss_en: royal contracts granting the slave trade
cards.ex_en: The merchants sought assientos to trade in slaves.
cards.ex_cn: 商人们谋求贩奴专营的合同。

cards.gloss_en: took the whole of a trade into few hands
cards.ex_en: A few rich men had engrossed the whole grain trade.
cards.ex_cn: 几个富人垄断了整个粮食贸易。

cards.gloss_en: ordering or urging someone to do something
cards.ex_en: The judge kept enjoining silence in the court.
cards.ex_cn: 法官不断责令法庭保持肃静。

cards.gloss_en: a person or thing that ruins or destroys
cards.ex_en: His own greed was the destroyer of his fortune.
cards.ex_cn: 他自己的贪婪毁掉了他的家财。

cards.gloss_en: to hold back or control something
cards.ex_en: He could not restrain his desire to travel.
cards.ex_cn: 他无法抑制外出旅行的欲望。

cards.gloss_en: solemn formal agreements or promises
cards.ex_en: The two parties signed strict covenants.
cards.ex_cn: 双方签订了严格的契约。

cards.gloss_en: an island, especially a small one
cards.ex_en: A tiny green isle rose from the sea.
cards.ex_cn: 一座小小的绿岛从海中升起。

cards.gloss_en: a sudden violent tropical storm
cards.ex_en: A tornado swept the ship far off course.
cards.ex_cn: 一场热带风暴把船刮得远离航线。

cards.gloss_en: moving fast, driven by the wind
cards.ex_en: The ship went scudding before the gale.
cards.ex_cn: 船乘着大风疾驶向前。

cards.gloss_en: the distance east or west on the earth's surface
cards.ex_en: They measured the ship's longitude at noon.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在正午测量船的经度。

cards.gloss_en: the buying and selling of goods
cards.ex_en: The port grew rich on foreign commerce.
cards.ex_cn: 这港口靠外贸变得富裕。

cards.gloss_en: the place where someone or something is
cards.ex_en: No one knew the whereabouts of the lost ship.
cards.ex_cn: 没人知道失踪船只的下落。

cards.gloss_en: behind a ship; toward the rear
cards.ex_en: A great wave rolled up astern of the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 一个大浪从船后翻涌而来。

cards.gloss_en: near in place or time
cards.ex_en: The end of the journey was drawing nigh.
cards.ex_cn: 旅程的终点渐渐临近。

cards.gloss_en: a person who does evil or breaks the law
cards.ex_en: The malefactor was led away to prison.
cards.ex_cn: 那作恶者被押往监狱。
